حَارِىٌّ Made in the town of El-Heereh: applied to a sword, and a camel's saddle. (TA.) And A kind of leathern housings, made in El-Heereh, with which camels' saddles are ornamented. (TA.) ＝
-A2- حَارِىَّ دَهْرٍ and حَارِىَّ الدَّهْرِ: see what next follows.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
